title: Investigating the binding mechanism of AML inhibitors based on panobinostat with HDAC3 proteins using Gaussian accelerated molecular dynamics
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,26240-26252
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01129A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xia Yu, Hengzheng Yang, Baiji Xue, Tong Liu, Xue Zhang, Yang Xu, Xueliang Zhao, Xianwen Yue
HDAC3 is a key cancer therapy target. Using Gaussian accelerated molecular dynamics, we found that 13a induces greater flexibility, stronger binding, and higher inhibitory potency against HDAC3, making it a promising candidate for cancer treatment.
